notes: Example only: these bounds are a site choice, not a limit the upstream clone states. Replace them with the envelope of the flight space at deployment.

y.reason: example: keep the drone inside a 1 m wide box

z.reason: example: below 1.5 m and not below the floor

yaw.reason: example: keep the heading near the start heading

vx.reason: example: slow translational velocity in the upstream value

vy.reason: example: slow translational velocity in the upstream value

vz.reason: example: slow vertical velocity in the upstream value

yaw_rate.reason: example: at most one radian per second of yaw
